existingReply: Intentional compatibility boundary, so I am not changing this branch. This PR scopes default-following and explicit `/agent` paths; profile backend, saved-layout restore, historical resume, and other non-`/agent` override owners are explicitly out of scope to avoid changing existing behavior. `TestDefaultProviderYoloInheritance` locks the `(false, false)` case, while `doc/specs/Yolo-mode.md` defines runtime provider selection for `/agent`. Leaving this thread open for maintainer review.
